```yaml
name: E2E Portal Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

jobs:
  e2e-portal-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    services:
      # Assuming Portal infrastructure requires a database or similar service.
      # Adjust based on actual Portal dependencies.
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: portal_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy, rustfmt

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache Cargo index
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-

      - name: Cache target directory
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-

      - name: Build imix_connect with SOCKS5 UDP support
        run: |
          # Ensure features for SOCKS5 UDP are enabled if defined in Cargo.toml
          # Adjust the feature flag name if different (e.g., socks5_udp, udp_support)
          cargo build --release --features socks5_udp

      - name: Setup Node.js for Playwright
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        run: |
          cd e2e-tests/portal # Adjust path to your Playwright project directory
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Start Portal Infrastructure
        run: |
          # Start the portal backend services in the background
          # Adjust command to match your actual startup script
          cargo run --bin portal-server &
          sleep 10 # Wait for server to initialize

      - name: Run Playwright UI Tests
        run: |
          cd e2e-tests/portal
          npx playwright test

      - name: Run Traffic Verification Scripts
        run: |
          # Run scripts to verify traffic routing, including SOCKS5 UDP
          # Adjust path and command to your verification scripts
          ./scripts/verify_traffic.sh

      - name: Upload Playwright Report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: e2e-tests/portal/playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30
```
